text: What if World War Three wasn't fought with nukes, but with time itself?
text0: What if World War Three wasn't fought with nukes, but with time itself?

text: In Tenet, an unnamed CIA agent, known only as The Protagonist, survives a brutal siege at a Kyiv opera house, where a mysterious masked soldier with an orange trinket saves his life, using a bullet that flies backward.
After passing a lethal loyalty test, he is recruited into a secret organization called Tenet.
His mission: stop inversion, a technology from the future that reverses an object's entropy, so it moves backward through time.
The man behind it in the present is Andrei Say-tor, a ruthless Russian oligarch, receiving inverted gold and instructions from future antagonists.
text0: The man behind it in the present is Andrei Sator, a ruthless Russian oligarch, receiving inverted gold and instructions from future antagonists.

text: Their goal is to assemble the Algorithm, a nine-part doomsday device capable of inverting the entire planet and wiping out the past.
To reach Say-tor, The Protagonist teams up with a sharp handler named Neil, and Say-tor's estranged wife, Kat.
text0: To reach Sator, The Protagonist teams up with a sharp handler named Neil, and Sator's estranged wife, Kat.

text: Their hunt leads from crashing a Boeing 747 into an Oz-lo freeport, to a chaotic highway heist in Tal-in.
text0: Their hunt leads from crashing a Boeing 747 into an Oslo freeport, to a chaotic highway heist in Tallinn.

text: There, an inverted Say-tor captures the final piece of the Algorithm, and shoots Kat with an inverted bullet.
text0: There, an inverted Sator captures the final piece of the Algorithm, and shoots Kat with an inverted bullet.

text: To save her life, The Protagonist and Neil enter a turnstile, inverting themselves to travel backward in time.

Meanwhile, Say-tor, who is dying of cancer, plans to end his life on his yacht in Vee-et-nam, triggering a dead-man's switch that will bury the Algorithm forever at a Soviet-era blast site called Stalsk twelve.
text0: Meanwhile, Sator, who is dying of cancer, plans to end his life on his yacht in Vietnam, triggering a dead-man's switch that will bury the Algorithm forever at a Soviet-era blast site called Stalsk-12.

text: Tenet launches a massive temporal pincer movement at Stalsk twelve, attacking with forward-moving and inverted soldiers at once.
text0: Tenet launches a massive temporal pincer movement at Stalsk-12, attacking with forward-moving and inverted soldiers at once.

text: While Kat stalls Say-tor on his yacht and kills him just after the Algorithm is pulled from the blast site, an inverted soldier takes a fatal bullet to save The Protagonist.
text0: While Kat stalls Sator on his yacht and kills him just after the Algorithm is pulled from the blast site, an inverted soldier takes a fatal bullet to save The Protagonist.

text: Afterward, The Protagonist spots the orange trinket on Neil's bag.

Neil reveals that a future version of The Protagonist recruited him years ago, and that he's going back to sacrifice himself. The Protagonist realizes he is the founder of Tenet, and the whole film was his own master plan.
